title: CSI volume generation after KMS rotation
text: The workload identity annotation still pins vault lease generation N. A new secret engine version is invisible until the replica set rolls and remounts the CSI volume.

title: Diagnosing credential version skew
text: Compare the secret checksum inside the container with the current KMS alias. HTTP 401 on a subset of pods after rotation is typical of mixed generations, not of an expired edge certificate.

title: Ingress notAfter in the past
text: cert-manager never completed the order. The tls secret notAfter is yesterday. The deployment itself answers 200 on the pod IP.

title: Handshake versus application 401
text: A TLS alert happens before HTTP. Application 401 after a successful handshake is a different class. Check SAN coverage and the ingress secret, not vault leases.

title: nscd and CoreDNS still hold the drained A record
text: Failover updated the public zone but office resolvers and node nscd honor a long TTL. Traffic continues to the drained cluster IP.

title: Split-horizon after promote
text: dig @8.8.8.8 already shows the new address while workstation nslookup does not. Flush nscd; do not rotate application secrets.

title: Hikari active equals max while Postgres is idle
text: Threads block on getConnection. pg_stat_activity shows few backends. The bottleneck is the application pool, not database CPU.

title: Timeouts with idle CPU
text: Checkout latency tracks pool wait, not query time. Increase maxLifetime leak detection before adding replicas.

title: Mesh subset still sending weight to revision B
text: Endpoints list two revisions. Canary weight is nonzero. Error rate matches the fraction of traffic on B.

title: Intermittent errors after release
text: Header-based routing plus a default subset explains why only some users fail. This is not a secret checksum split across pods.

title: Shared token bucket and retry storm
text: The partner gateway returns 429 with Retry-After. The client multiplies retries and burns the shared quota for every caller.

title: Throttling versus pool wait
text: Upstream 429s include a token-bucket header. Database pool wait does not. Back off before scaling consumers.

title: Kafka consumer lag climbing while produce succeeds
text: Producer ACKs are fine. Consumer group lag and DLQ depth grow. Email send is gated on the consumer.

title: Late side effects with successful enqueue
text: API latency is normal because enqueue is local. Hours-late mail is drain lag, not CDN cache.

title: OOMKilled and lastState terminated
text: The container lastState is OOMKilled. restartCount climbs. 502s align with the restart gap.

title: Periodic 502 with memory limit
text: RSS sits at the limit then drops to zero. This is not replica lag and not a cached error page.

title: chrony offset outside the signing window
text: Node time is ninety seconds fast. SigV4 and JWT nbf fail only on that node.

title: Token not valid yet on one node
text: The same key works on peers. NTP offset explains not-yet-valid tokens; do not rotate the KMS alias.

title: Sticky bucketing disagrees across services
text: Checkout-web and payments-api hash different keys so assignment splits. SDK cache is stale on one side.

title: Half of sessions on the new path
text: Percentage rollout plus mismatched context keys yields a 50/50 split that is not a canary mesh weight.

title: Edge Age header still serving a 503 body
text: Origin now returns 200. The CDN object has a large Age and stale-if-error leftover. Purge the surrogate key.

title: Public URL stale after origin recovery
text: curl to origin is fine; curl through the zone is not. This is edge cache, not consumer lag.

title: Seconds behind source after promote
text: The promoted replica had not applied the last GTID. Reads in the new region return yesterday's rows.

title: Stale balances after region promote
text: Write path is on the new primary; read replicas were promoted too early. Flushing DNS will not fix row versions.
